notes.title: Character Creator Is Here!
notes.content:
[b][h3]🎯 5k Wishlists Milestone![/h3][/b]

We’ve just hit an incredible milestone—5,000 Wishlists on Steam! 🚀 This is a huge achievement, and I can’t thank you enough for your support. What started as a simple idea is now blossoming into a full-fledged game that we’ll all get to enjoy and play together

To celebrate this milestone, I’ve got some exciting updates to share with you I've been working updating and improving performance, aesthetics, animations, and so much more. But first, let’s dive into one of the most exciting features…

[h3][b]
🎨 Character Creator Preview![/b][/h3]

I’ve added a sneak peek video of our brand-new Character Creator! The system is still in development, but I’m aiming to give you the power to create any anime character you can imagine and bring them into your cozy adventure! Plus, sharing your characters with the community will be a breeze—you’ll be able to generate an image of your character and easily share it with everyone! 💖

[h3][b]
🚧 Demo Update![/b][/h3]

As of today, the Steam demo is temporarily disabled. But don’t worry—I’ve been gathering ton of valuable feedback from you all, and I’m so grateful for the time and effort you’ve put into helping shape Cozy Crest. A new demo currently in the making featuring the Character Creator, If you’d like to support the game and try Character Creator early on you can join Cozy Crest on Patreon and get early access before everyone else once the character creator is finished!

[h2][url=https://www.patreon.com/CozyCrest]Patreon[/url][/h2]

Thank you again for all the love and support! Cozy Crest wouldn’t be what it is without this amazing community! 💜

notes.title: Cozy Crest Update v0.6
notes.content:
I hope you’re all doing fantastic! I have some exciting news to share with you today. I've been working hard on the game and trailer, and I'm thrilled to announce that new update is now Live! and I've decided to add some amazing new features!

Demo Updates:

🆕 The latest update is now live! It includes all the recent changes, so be sure to check out ⁠in [url=https://discord.gg/YBduQdEHzk]discord[/url] for the details.

Next up is the character customization system, allowing you to see your unique characters in-game. We’ll continue rotating different demos to test various systems before the official release.

Game Scope:

I've decided to broaden the game’s scope and bring in additional hires. Here’s what you can expect in Cozy Crest:

🌍 Biomes: A larger open world with diverse landscapes.
🐾 Pets: You can cuddle, teach new moves, and take them on your adventures.
💑 NPCs: Enhanced personalities, love interests, and story lines for the 12 dateable characters.
🎉 World Events: Random events around player characters to keep world exploration exciting.
🎮 Mini Games: Fishing, cooking, catching pets, gliding, and clan-based challenges.

Game Release Date:

📅 I’ll likely move the release date forward to polish the game further and incorporate all the cool features mentioned above. However, you can always get the latest alpha build on 

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/CozyCrest

which directly supports the game and provides you access to latest alpha build!

Thank you for being the best supporters of Cozy Crest. Have a wonderful day! ☀️

notes.title: Cozy Crest Closed Alpha Now avaiable
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Eq1ZFpHAeAo;full][/previewyoutube]

Get Closed Alpha here https://www.patreon.com/cozycrest/

Cozy Crest Pre-alpha build 

New Features :

Hub menu all essential menus in one place and easier to add controller support in the future
Added Player World Interaction System (Player characters will now look at things Camera, other characters ..etc)
World Map (points of interest, landmarks, upgraded minimap)
Journal system (quest tracking, quest selection, rewards)
New inventory system (cleaner and easier to add compatibility controller support)
Add character selection screen (select & name character on start of the game)
Improved Waypoints System 
Added few quests 
New Trade menu


User Interface :

Moved map & date to the top right of the screen
Moved player currency under map 
Moved questing Widget to the left side of the screen gave it more space and adjusted the UI for multiple quests 
Updated Character Portraits
Updated & Improved Conversation UI 
Dialogue now displays with type writer method instead of just popping out 
Dialogue now has a blinking bottom arrow to indicate to the player the dialogue line is over and they can skip to the next one 
Left Click + Enter + Space to move to the next dialogue line
Journal Ability to remove / add quests from the pin


Bug Fixes & Improvements :

fixed a bug player can't select any toolbelt items
add default 60 fps and medium settings for all devices
fixed Issue: Negative energy
fixed Issue: Water can is empty, but still doing water animation.
fixed Issue:  Can harvest fiber infinitely while standing in one spot, even if there is no grass.
fixed broken notification
fixed an issue that didn't allow you to fill water near water sources
fixed an issue When getting items multiple times sometimes they don't stack and just add up
fixed Issue: Unable to select any tools or menu items after messing around with my radial menu
fixed Wood piles reappear after a short amount of time
fixed mini map location projection
fixed waypoints location projection
fixed Mashing the jump button causes the jump animation to pause or restart before jump reaches max height
fixed widget / quest highlight not appearing in shipping builds
fixed talking to NPCs makes the camera zoom in way too far. 
fixed as you gain more than 8 items, the hot-bar registers them all bound to "8" this causes "8" to change in the hot-bar to whatever item was last picked up
fixed Unable to select any tools or menu items after messing around with my radial menu.
fixed failed attempt at using watering can still costs energy
fixed Water can is empty, but still doing water animation
fixed Pressing start again doesn't close the main menu
swapped quest markers for better ones (higher quality)
Add icons to notifications 
Added new items icons to fit more with the game artstyle 
Add World map player location projection
Add Waypoints world map location projection
Added night time ambiance 
added Add Settings option on main screen
added new camera for Building system that's more accurate and easier to see where the buildings would go
Gliding no longer requires holding the jump button (one press to toggle) 
Improved gliding turning / speed / falling
..etc

notes.title: Cozy Crest Update v0.55
notes.content:
[b]New Features :[/b]


Added ability to interact with apple trees gain apples from them and consume it, consuming the item will restore energy 
Added Strawberry bushes that will appear during Spring you can interact with them and gain strawberry consuming it will restore energy 
Added Iron ore veins around the world, large, medium, small veins
 

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements :[/b]

Player no longer get stuck in the doorway 
Quest UI no longer fade out after progressing on tasks
Starting stamina is doubled (from 120 to 240)
You now get a warning when you don't have enough stamina to use tools
Using tools like Axe / Pickaxe without hitting resources no longer cost energy 
Scythe no longer limited to single use on grass you can keep going around cutting smaller grass
Added a large ocean covering the island to smooth up the transition from afar
Updated & added few items & icons (Berries, Iron Ore, Fiber, Apple)
Plotted land no longer rotated / crooked 
Plotted lands beside each other no longer overlap 
Removed hidden collision object near the house prevent player from farming around
Grass no longer grows on plotted land after plotting
Fixed an issue with the player falling under water and breaking controls sometime 
In-game menu will now pause the game
Quest dialogue no longer auto plays you have to press a button to proceed 
Going to sleep no longer gets the player out of the capsule 
minor graphical glitches fixes

[b]Controller :[/b]

Start button now opens main menu
Select button hides UI 
Circle Now allows use to use tools as well no longer using R2 for tools
